title: Post-restoration database proof execution and migration drift-detector correction
note_on_attempt_identity: No new attempt was opened. MD-B03-A001 was already IN_PROGRESS and owns the migration framework and test harness contract area, which is where the corrected drift detector belongs. MD-B00-A002 is closed and its immutable records were not edited.
trigger: MariaDB at 127.0.0.1:3306 was unreachable at MD-B00-A002 closure. The database-dependent proofs deferred then have now been executed against the restored server, and every record below reflects actual execution rather than the pre-outage expectation.

deferred_proofs_now_executed.result: executed; defect found in the detector itself

defect_found_and_fixed.defect: test_no_applied_migration_has_lost_its_file asserted count($orphans) <= count($applied). Orphans is a subset of applied, so the assertion is true by construction and can never fail. It then called addToAssertionCount(1) when orphans existed, so the suite reported an assertion that tested nothing. Eleven applied migrations had no file for the entire period the test was green.
defect_found_and_fixed.second_defect: appliedMigrations() hardcoded host, database, user, and an empty password. In any environment differing from that literal it returned null and both drift directions skipped. A skip is indistinguishable from "no drift found", which is the outcome drift detection exists to prevent.
defect_found_and_fixed.fix: Direction two now asserts zero in-scope orphans and pins the out-of-scope set by identifier. The connection is read from the configured .env.
defect_found_and_fixed.scope_judgement: The 11 orphans are Watchlist-domain migrations whose files live in another package. MARKET_DATA_DOCUMENT_AUTHORITY.md clause 6 places watchlist outside market-data acceptance authority, so they are not market-data drift. They are pinned by name rather than filtered silently, so a new orphan must be classified deliberately instead of being absorbed by a pattern. The sync contract requires the identifiers involved to be recorded in both directions, which pinning satisfies.
defect_found_and_fixed.not_a_weakening: A tautology was replaced by two assertions that can fail. In-scope orphans must be zero; the out-of-scope set must match exactly. Neither existed before.
